Joint posterior draws of the variance components of an INLA fit

Source: R/methods_inla.R
fb_variance_draws.Rd

Draws the hyperparameters of an INLA fit jointly and returns them on the scale and under the names of the fit's variance-component table (summary(fit)$varcomp): a standard deviation for the residual (sigma) and for each random term (sd_<term>), and a correlation as it is.

Usage

fb_variance_draws(object, n, seed = NULL)

Arguments

object

A flexybayes_inla fit.

n

The number of draws.

seed

An integer seed, or NULL (the default) to use the session's random number stream.

Value

A data frame with n rows and one column per variance component.

Details

The draws come from INLA::inla.hyperpar.sample() and are mapped to the response's original scale. A hyperparameter held fixed, such as the precision of a known variance, is not drawn. With seed, the draws from a given fit are repeatable on one INLA thread (options(flexyBayes.inla_threads = "1:1")). A refit of the same model in another R session can reach a different mode (see flexybayes(), section INLA threads).

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("INLA", quietly = TRUE)) {
  set.seed(1)
  d <- data.frame(site = factor(rep(1:6, each = 5)))
  d$y <- rnorm(6)[d$site] + rnorm(30)
  fit <- flexybayes(y ~ 1, random = ~site, data = d, backend = "inla",
                    verbose = FALSE)
  head(fb_variance_draws(fit, 100L, seed = 1L))
}
# }
